Saving

⌘S writes your highlights, comments and overall thoughts into the PDF as standard comments, so they open in Acrobat, Preview and everywhere else — and come back when you reopen the file here, even in another browser. In Chrome or Edge, open the PDF with the Open button and it saves in place, and Autosave (under Settings) does that for you after every change; otherwise ⌘S gives you an annotated copy. Notes are always kept in this browser as you work.

Page numbers

Under Settings (the sliders icon), tell it which PDF page is script page 1 (usually 2 when there's a title page). Notes, scenes and exports then use script page numbers. A title page is detected automatically when it can be.
